The '''Cholganna system''', also known as the '''Chol system''',<ref name="Rim" /> was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]].
